title: Ama Dablam Expedition (6,812m)
overview: Ama Dablam (6,812m) is widely regarded as one of the most beautiful and coveted technical peak climbs in the Himalayas. Known as the 'Matterhorn of the Himalayas', this expedition combines severe vertical rock, mixed snow, ice climbing, and breathtaking exposure along the South-West Ridge route.
highlights: Summit the iconic 6,812m Ama Dablam pinnacle via the classic South-West Ridge
Fixed rope vertical rock climbing on the famous Yellow Tower and Grey Tower
Dedicated 1:1 IFMGA / NMA Certified High Altitude Sherpa Guide ratio
Spectacular Base Camp luxury setup with full dining, private tents, and internet
Stunning views of Everest, Lhotse, Makalu, and Cho Oyu from high camps
inclusionsText: Full logistics support, IFMGA summit guide 1:1 ratio, NMA climbing permits, garbage deposit, Kathmandu hotel 4 nights, flight Kathmandu-Lukla-Kathmandu, all high altitude meals and tents, fixed rope charges.
exclusionsText: International airfare, Nepal visa fees, personal summit climbing gear, personal travel/evacuation insurance, guide/staff tips ($500+ recommended), personal alcohol & expenses.
included: 1:1 IFMGA Certified Sherpa Guide ratio
Official NMA Expedition Permit & National Park Fees
Round-trip domestic flights (Kathmandu - Lukla - Kathmandu)
Full Base Camp & High Camp logistics, tents, and meals
Fixed rope and safety gear deployment
Kathmandu 4-Star Hotel accommodation (4 nights with breakfast)
excluded: Climbing gear rental (crampons, ice axes, harness, boots)
Summit bonus for Sherpa guide ($800 - $1000 standard)
metaTitle: Ama Dablam Expedition 6812m | Technical Himalaya Peak Climb

itinerary.title: Arrival in Kathmandu & Transfer to Hotel
itinerary.description: Arrive at Tribhuvan International Airport in Kathmandu. Transfer to hotel, rest, and evening team welcome dinner with expedition leaders.

itinerary.description: Official Ministry of Tourism briefing, gear inspection with IFMGA guides, and final permit checks.

itinerary.description: Scenic 35-minute flight to Tenzing-Hillary Airport in Lukla. Begin trek through Sherpa villages along the Dudh Koshi river to Phakding.

itinerary.description: Ascend through pine forests, cross high suspension bridges, and climb up to the vibrant Sherpa capital of Namche Bazaar.

itinerary.title: Acclimatization Day at Namche Bazaar
itinerary.description: Hike to Everest View Hotel (3,880m) for panoramic views of Ama Dablam, Lhotse, and Everest. Return to Namche for preparation.

itinerary.title: Trek to Tengboche Monastery
itinerary.description: Follow the cliffside trail with magnificent views of Ama Dablam soaring above, reaching the historic Tengboche Monastery.

itinerary.title: Trek to Pangboche
itinerary.description: Descend through rhododendron forests to Deboche, then cross the Imja Khola to Pangboche village, home of summit Sherpas.

itinerary.title: Trek to Ama Dablam Base Camp
itinerary.description: Leave the main trail and ascend grassy slopes directly beneath the soaring face of Ama Dablam to set up Base Camp.

itinerary.title: Puja Ceremony & Base Camp Rest
itinerary.description: Traditional Sherpa Buddhist Puja ceremony to ask the mountain deity for safe passage. Gear organization and rope practice.

itinerary.title: Rotation 1: Hike to Yak Camp
itinerary.description: First rotation carrying high altitude gear up to Yak Camp (5,400m) for acclimatization practice.

itinerary.title: Rotation 1: Touch Camp 1 & Return to Base Camp
itinerary.description: Climb up granite boulders to Camp 1 (5,700m). Practice jumar techniques on fixed ropes before returning to Base Camp.

itinerary.title: Rest & Acclimatization at Base Camp
itinerary.description: Full recovery day at Base Camp. Massages, gear tuning, and weather forecast analysis.

itinerary.title: Climbing Window: Move to Camp 1
itinerary.description: Ascend to Camp 1 via Yak Camp across boulder fields and slab rock sections.

itinerary.title: Climb to Camp 2 (The Yellow Tower)
itinerary.description: Navigate technical granite ridges including the 5.7 Yellow Tower pitch to establish Camp 2 on narrow rock ledge.

itinerary.title: Climb to Camp 3 (Mushroom Ridge)
itinerary.description: Cross the famous snow-and-ice Mushroom Ridge to pitch Camp 3 beneath the Dablam glacier hanging ice face.

itinerary.title: SUMMIT PUSH: Ama Dablam (6,812m) & Return to Camp 2
itinerary.description: Midnight alpine start. Ascend steep 50-degree ice slopes alongside the Dablam hanging glacier to reach the summit pyramid (6,812m). Unrivaled 360-degree Himalayan panorama. Rappel down safely to Camp 2.

itinerary.title: Descend from Camp 2 to Base Camp
itinerary.description: Rappel down the remaining fixed ropes past Camp 1 and Yak Camp, returning to warm hospitality at Base Camp.

itinerary.title: Contingency / Reserve Weather Day

itinerary.title: Contingency / Reserve Weather Day 2

itinerary.title: Base Camp Teardown & Packing

itinerary.title: Trek Base Camp to Pangboche
itinerary.description: Descend from Base Camp back to Pangboche village and celebrate with local lodge owners.

itinerary.title: Trek Pangboche to Namche Bazaar

itinerary.title: Flight Lukla to Kathmandu

itinerary.title: Farewell Celebration Dinner

itinerary.title: Buffer Day for International Departures
itinerary.description: Relaxation and packing day in Kathmandu.

itinerary.title: Final Departure from Kathmandu
itinerary.description: Airport transfer for international homeward flight.

faqs.question: What technical experience is required for Ama Dablam?
faqs.answer: Climbers must have prior experience with 5000m-6000m peaks, proficiency with jumars on fixed ropes, 5.7 rock climbing capability, and front-pointing with crampons on 50-degree ice.

faqs.question: What is the guide-to-climber ratio on the summit push?
faqs.answer: We maintain a strict 1:1 ratio between climbing Sherpa and climber above Base Camp for maximum safety and individual pacing.

reviews.author: Markus Weber
reviews.title: The pinnacle of my mountaineering journey!
reviews.comment: Ama Dablam was a dream come true. The technical rock on the Yellow Tower and snow ridge to the summit were unbelievable. Alpine Ace's 1:1 Sherpa support was exceptional.

title: Island Peak (Imja Tse) Expedition (6,189m)
overview: Island Peak (6,189m), locally known as Imja Tse, is Nepal's most popular trekking peak. Rising in the middle of the Chhukung valley, it offers an incredible introduction to Himalayan high altitude mountaineering with a non-extreme technical glacier wall traverse.
highlights: Summit 6,189m Island Peak with breathtaking views of Lhotse South Face and Makalu
Comprehensive glacier and climbing training day at High Camp
Combined with the legendary Everest Base Camp and Kala Patthar trek
Crossing the final headwall using fixed lines and ascenders

exclusionsText: International flights, personal climbing boots/crampons, travel insurance covering search & rescue up to 6500m, personal drinks and tips.
included: NMA Peak Climbing Permit & Sagarmatha Park Fees

title: Mera Peak Expedition (6,476m)
overview: Mera Peak (6,476m) is Nepal's highest official trekking peak. Situated in the remote Hinku Valley, it offers straightforward non-technical glacier walking with what is considered the finest summit panorama in the entire Himalayas—viewing 5 of the world's 14 8,000m peaks.
highlights: Stand on the highest trekking peak in Nepal (6,476m)
Panoramic views of 5 eight-thousand meter peaks: Everest, Lhotse, Cho Oyu, Makalu, and Kanchenjunga
Trek through the untouched, pristine wilderness of the Hinku Valley
Ideal first 6000m high-altitude peak climb
inclusionsText: NMA climbing permit, high camp tents & meals, experienced climbing guide, flights Lukla/Kathmandu, camping & teahouse stay.
exclusionsText: Personal trekking & climbing gear, personal travel insurance with high altitude rescue, tips and alcohol.
included: Mera Peak NMA Climbing Permit & Local Permits
Licensed IFMGA/NMA Climbing Sherpa Guide (1:2)
Domestic Flights (Kathmandu - Lukla - Kathmandu)
High Camp Camping Equipment & Full Meals
Safety Rope & Medical First Aid Kit
excluded: Personal mountaineering plastic/double boots & climbing harness

Stunning look down over the Khumbu Glacier and Everest Base Camp
Steep technical fixed line ascent on crisp alpine snow walls
Combine with Everest Base Camp acclimatization trek

exclusionsText: Personal gear rental, rescue insurance, tips.

title: Himlung Himal Expedition (7,126m)
overview: Himlung Himal (7,126m) lies in the remote Nar-Phu region north of Annapurna, close to the Tibetan border. It is recognized as one of the safest and most accessible 7,000m peaks in Nepal, making it the ultimate stepping stone for climbers targeting 8,000m giants like Manaslu or Everest.
highlights: Summit a real 7,000m Himalayan giant (7,126m)
Trek through the forbidden, ancient Tibetan-culture villages of Nar and Phu
Full high-altitude support with supplementary oxygen and 1:1 Sherpa guide ratio
Ideal preparation peak for Everest or 8,000m peaks
inclusionsText: Department of Tourism 7000m Climbing Permit, Nar-Phu Restricted Area Permits, 1:1 IFMGA Summit Sherpa, Summit Oxygen Set (2 bottles + Mask/Regulator), full Base Camp and High Camp management.
exclusionsText: International airfare, personal high altitude down suit, personal gear, tips for summit Sherpa ($1000+).
included: Official 7000m Nepal Government Expedition Permit
1:1 Dedicated Summit Sherpa Guide
2 Oxygen Cylinders per climber with TopOut Mask
Full Base Camp (4,850m) and 3 High Camps setup
All overland transfers by private 4WD Jeeps
excluded: Travel insurance including high altitude evacuation up to 7500m
